# Tadepalligudem Property — 2 BHK Independent House for Sale

> A single-property listing for a 2 BHK independent house in Karri Satyavathi Nagar, Tadepalligudem, West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, India. Sold directly by the owner (no broker) at an asking price of ₹32 lakh. This is one specific house, not a property portal.

Site: https://houseforsellaroundme.github.io/independent-house-for-sell/
Last updated: 24 September 2026
Language: English (India). Currency: Indian Rupees (INR).

Listing details are provided by the owner and have not been independently verified. Buyers must verify title, approvals, measurements, taxes and all other details before purchase.

## Property Summary

- Type: Independent residential house (not an apartment or flat), resale
- Configuration: 2 BHK, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms
- Asking price: ₹32 lakh (₹32,00,000), approx. ₹2,909 per sq ft of built-up area
- Built-up area: approx. 1,100 sq ft
- Plot size: 2.88 cents
- Facing: East, with a north-east entrance
- Parking: 1 vehicle
- Water: Borewell
- Age: Approx. 8 years
- Property tax: Municipal tax stated as paid
- Seller: Owner, direct sale, no broker
- Locality: Karri Satyavathi Nagar, Tadepalligudem, West Godavari, Andhra Pradesh
- Nearby: Government Hospital, Tadepalligudem; two temples in the vicinity
- Approximate coordinates: 16.822528, 81.539639

## Infrastructure Note

The Andhra Pradesh government has launched a pre-feasibility study for a proposed airport in Tadepalligudem. The project is at the assessment stage only. It may or may not go ahead, and no timelines are confirmed. Buyers should not base a purchase decision solely on it.

## Buyer Due Diligence

Buyers should independently verify: ownership and title documents, property tax records with the municipality, plot and built-up measurements, approvals and permissions, utility connections, encumbrance records, registration requirements and stamp duty, physical condition, boundaries and access road, and any pending dues.
